routeInstruction: Reuse batch01 guarded FoodDailyObjectiveGapSupport/isFoodDailyObjectiveGapContext route, before figureBindings lookup and after level guard. The same component permits three additional exact lesson IDs. Do not duplicate route or replace other native delegates. Full current source paragraphs required internally.
route: if(isFoodDailyObjectiveGapContext(lesson.id)) return <FoodDailyObjectiveGapSupport lessonId={lesson.id} lessonSourceHash={lesson.sourceHash} lessonRevision={lesson.revision} level={level} language={language} showTranslation={showTranslation} colors={colors} paragraphIds={paragraphIds}/>;
